parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS value),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO hwc.event_cases (fingerprint, title, start_at, end_at, location, description, url, source, track)
  SELECT value->>'fingerprint', value->>'title', (value->>'startAt')::timestamptz, NULLIF(value->>'endAt','')::timestamptz, value->>'location', value->>'description', value->>'url', value->>'source', value->>'track' FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, start_at=EXCLUDED.start_at, end_at=EXCLUDED.end_at, location=EXCLUDED.location, description=EXCLUDED.description, url=EXCLUDED.url, source=EXCLUDED.source, track=EXCLUDED.track, last_seen_at=now(), updated_at=now()
  RETURNING fingerprint
), judged AS (
  INSERT INTO hwc.event_curation_judgments (fingerprint, run_key, rule_version, outcome, score, score_components, reasons)
  SELECT value->>'fingerprint', value->>'runKey', value->'curation'->>'ruleVersion', value->'curation'->>'decision', (value->'curation'->>'score')::int, value->'curation'->'components', value->'curation'->'reasons' FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (fingerprint, run_key, rule_version) DO NOTHING
)
SELECT input.value AS card, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hwc.event_deliveries d WHERE d.fingerprint=input.value->>'fingerprint') AS should_publish FROM input;
